description: This file defines a Python module for parsing C++ interface definitions and generating JSON-RPC interface schemas. It includes classes, functions, and logic for handling C++ types, methods, and interface metadata, and constructs JSON schemas for interfaces, methods, properties, and events.

classes.name: CppParseError
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling C++ parsing errors with detailed context.

methods.name: LoadInterface
methods.description: Main function to load C++ interface definitions from a file, parse them, and generate JSON schema representations.
